name: tia_list_technology_objects
description: List the technology objects of a PLC (the 'Technology objects' folder, including its subfolders) with system-library type, version, DB number and folder path. Technology objects are not listed by tia_list_blocks. An instance DB of PID_Temp created from an SCL call is a plain instance DB, not a technology object, and does not appear here.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name (case-sensitive); required when the project has multiple PLCs.
